title: Restart Service and Repair App for end users
aliases: enable end user to restart services and repair app

prose.text: Users can restart or repair Client Connector from its More window if the admin allows it. Both actions briefly change how traffic is handled.

prose.label: Effect on enforcement.
prose.text: The vendor's article contradicts itself on this, saying both that a restart does not affect enforcement and that a restart or repair fails open briefly: {{restart-enforcement}} {{brief-fail-open}} An app profile can make the restart fail closed instead: [[zcc.app-profiles.advanced-settings:fail-close-lockdown]].

checks.do: Whether a short unfiltered window lines up with a user's restart or repair, and whether the app profile's Lockdown on Tunnel Process Exit was on.

options.statement: Users troubleshoot Client Connector with Restart Service or Repair App in its More window; Repair App exists only on Windows.

quotes: Users can troubleshoot the app by clicking Restart Service or Repair App from the More window of Zscaler Client Connector.
The Repair App feature is only available for Windows.

enable-setting.statement: The options are turned on with Enable End User to Restart Services and Repair App on the App Supportability page.

quotes: Click Enable End User to Restart Services and Repair App.
From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Advanced Settings > App Supportability.

repair-reinstalls.statement: Repair App tries to repair Client Connector by reinstalling what the page calls its app drives and services.

quotes: When users select Repair App, the app attempts to repair itself by reinstalling app drives and services.

restart-enforcement.statement: The vendor says restarting Client Connector does not affect security enforcement; on Android and Android on ChromeOS 3.8 and later, Restart Service can be clicked only once in 30 seconds.

quotes: Restarting Zscaler Client Connector doesn't impact security enforcement.
you can click Restart Service only once within a 30-second period for Zscaler Client Connector version 3.8 and later for Android
for Android and Zscaler Client Connector version 3.8 and later for Android on ChromeOS

brief-fail-open.statement: Restart Service and Repair App make Client Connector fail open briefly; the vendor's advice is to disable access to them where that is not acceptable.

quotes: Using Restart Service or Repair App causes Zscaler Client Connector to fail-open briefly. Disable access if this is not ideal.
